name: MiniMax H3 (10Eros Max 1.0)
author: TenStrip
description:
Model format: int8 ConvRot. Steps: 8 by default.

10Eros Max 1.0 for MiniMax H3: TenStrip's mix of beta5, beta7 and Sulphur 3 on a hybrid FL2VA base, turbo built in, 22.9 GB INT8 HQ. Text to video, image to video, reference to video and two 768p two-pass cards, on LCM at 8 steps. The author made it for explicit animation and suggests plain H3 for anything else. Runs dense rather than the author's sparse attention; the card text says why. A separate download from the beta5, beta6 and beta7 fix1 packs.

presets.name: MiniMax H3 Text to Video (10Eros Max 1.0)
presets.description:
Text to video on 10Eros Max 1.0. 10Eros Max 1.0 is TenStrip's mix of his beta5 and beta7 builds with SulphurAI's Sulphur 3, on a hybrid FL2VA base with the turbo built in, so there is no LoRA to load. The author made it for explicit animation and suggests plain MiniMax H3 for anything else. He says it adapts better to input pictures and poses than beta7, at the cost of some general knowledge.

A five-second 480p shot takes about 90 seconds on a 12 GB card in the app. For more resolution, use the 768p two-pass card.

It runs LCM with the simple schedule at 8 steps, as the author recommends. The Steps control covers his 8 to 12, but only 8 was tested here.

Sparse attention is left off. The author suggests it, but this checkpoint lacks the layers it needs: in our tests it saved about 9% of the time and came out about 30% softer.

Ordinary H3 LoRAs at high rank work poorly on this model, according to the author; he keeps a set of down-ranked LoRAs tested on it at huggingface.co/TenStrip/MMH3_Sulphur3Eros_Loras-MLP-energy-patches. No LoRAs were tested here.

This is a 22.9 GB download of its own, separate from the beta5, beta6 and beta7 fix1 packs.

Model format: int8 ConvRot.
presets.tagline: 10Eros Max 1.0: beta5, beta7 and Sulphur 3 mixed, 8 steps

extensions.name: ComfyUI-KJNodes
extensions.description: Provides PathchSageAttentionKJ for the faster-attention opt-in

requirements.notes: One 22.9 GB INT8 HQ checkpoint (TenStrip/10Eros-Max @875036a9) with the turbo baked in, plus the shared H3 text encoder and VAEs. lcm / simple, 8 steps, sigma shift 12 video / 3 audio set in the workflow. The file carries two tensors, adaln_basis and adaln_mean, that the engine does not read (logged as 'unet unexpected'); the test clips looked normal without them. MEASURED 2026-11-23 against the engine (RTX 4070 Ti 12 GB, 31 GB RAM, 864x480, 5 s, I2V, three seeds, kitchen attention, engine 0.45.0): 80 s per clip dense; VSA at 10% (no gate layers, so no coarse branch) 73 s and about 30% softer (Laplacian 240-273 against 358-370); er_sde/sgm_uniform looked and timed much the same as lcm/simple. Against beta7 fix1 on the same picture, prompt and seeds: background slide 6-36 px against 50-107 px, flicker 2.2-2.5 against 3.9-4.6, mid-frame sharpness 358-370 against 209-270, first-frame match 22.8-23.0 dB against 23.4-23.5, scripted line in 9 of 9 clips. In the app (1.92, engine 0.46.2, seed 4242, 5 s at the card's default size) this card took 88 s.

Against beta7 fix1 on the same picture, prompt and seeds, it held a locked-off camera much better (it slid 1-4% of the frame width over five seconds instead of 6-12%, though it crept in by 2-4%), flickered about half as much and came out sharper. The scripted line came out in every clip.

extensions.name: Comfyui_Minimax_h3_latent_Upscaler
extensions.description: Trained neural latent upscaler for MiniMax H3 (MinimaxH3LatentUpscaler3D). MUST be at commit d7c01b9 or later: 6a4b191 scrambles the second stage (blobby background, cyan skin) on this exact graph. No requirements.txt, torch only.

requirements.notes: One 22.9 GB INT8 HQ checkpoint (TenStrip/10Eros-Max @875036a9) with the turbo baked in, plus the shared H3 text encoder and VAEs. lcm / simple, 8 steps, sigma shift 12 video / 3 audio set in the workflow. The file carries two tensors, adaln_basis and adaln_mean, that the engine does not read (logged as 'unet unexpected'); the test clips looked normal without them. MEASURED 2026-11-23 against the engine (RTX 4070 Ti 12 GB, 31 GB RAM, 864x480, 5 s, I2V, three seeds, kitchen attention, engine 0.45.0): 80 s per clip dense; VSA at 10% (no gate layers, so no coarse branch) 73 s and about 30% softer (Laplacian 240-273 against 358-370); er_sde/sgm_uniform looked and timed much the same as lcm/simple. Against beta7 fix1 on the same picture, prompt and seeds: background slide 6-36 px against 50-107 px, flicker 2.2-2.5 against 3.9-4.6, mid-frame sharpness 358-370 against 209-270, first-frame match 22.8-23.0 dB against 23.4-23.5, scripted line in 9 of 9 clips. Two-pass adds the 0.69 GB latent upscaler and its custom node: a 0.55x first pass at 8 steps, the 3D latent upscaler, then 3 steps beta at 0.35 denoise at the chosen size, all on lcm, with the soundtrack taken from the first pass. In the app (1.92, engine 0.46.2, seed 4242, 5 s at the card's default size) this card took 200 s.
